question: Should editor exports and DOM contracts use neutral names across the Plate facade and its runtime, and which public nouns should disappear instead of being renamed?
trigger: User asks whether EditorRoot and EditorContent are standard and whether EditableRoot and EditableContent avoid conflict with the Editor interface; requests harsh honest feedback.
requirements: Distinguish the editor instance, React composition scope and document surface without brand names.
Support custom controls, content layouts and read-only presentation.
Prefer the clearest domain vocabulary; neither implementation cost nor existing names select the target.
Preserve the user-selected absence of prior branded wire-format compatibility.
evidenceReuse: Rechecked the current EditorRoot, EditorContent, EditorProvider and copied Editor implementations and reconciled the earlier component naming verdict. Verified current Radix Dialog, Base UI Dialog and Tiptap React official documentation for naming precedent.
summary: Keep EditorRoot and EditorContent. Stop the Editable-prefix rename: there is no identifier collision with Editor, and the family includes composition and read-only presentation.
alternatives: Keep EditorRoot and EditorContent: the common Editor domain plus explicit roles distinguishes the instance, composition scope and document surface.
Rename to EditableRoot and EditableContent: adds an editability term without resolving an actual identifier collision; weaker for read-only presentation and surrounding controls.
Merge the root into content: removes independent context composition for sibling controls and custom layouts, or forces equivalent coordination into props and slots.
Reuse EditorProvider as the root: conflates passive existing-editor binding with mounted React editor composition.
Use an Editor.Root/Editor.Content object namespace: viable style, but does not improve the requested distinction and consumes the exact Editor identifier that the user wants to keep clear.
Move ownership or add a primitive: no missing capability, state authority or lifecycle is evidenced by this naming question; retain current owners.
Rename the Editor interface or add aliases: makes the model vocabulary less direct or creates duplicate public names for no current benefit.
proofLimits: Source and current official documentation review only. The Root/Content pattern is established, not a universal editor standard; Base UI uses Popup for Dialog. No behavior, browser, performance or new implementation claim. The global review inventory was already stale during prior closure.
